issue_request: FHIR-33950 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by OO and asked that DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.marketDistribution sub-elements marketPeriod and subJurisdiction be mandated with minimum cardinality 1, complementing FHIR-32976.
initial_application: FHIR-32976 introduced marketDistribution with optional marketPeriod and subJurisdiction. Commit f8cefe81c5c2e493801523aa01875296c7e79243, titled "Fix #33950", changed both sub-elements from min 0 to min 1, and current blame still attributes the min lines to that commit.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is an active core resource in source/fhir.ini. DeviceDefinition.packaging.udiDeviceIdentifier now content-references #DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier, so the packaging UDI backbone inherits the same marketDistribution child cardinalities. FHIR-34840 later corrected the marketDistribution definition text without changing the cardinality decision. OO minutes confirm marketDistribution itself should remain 0..* while the child elements are 1..1.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml already has min 1/max 1 for DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.marketDistribution.marketPeriod and .subJurisdiction, with packaging reuse handled through contentReference.
